Our hotel is located in a convenient area of Fergana city, making it an excellent choice for both business and leisure trips. We offer our guests cozy rooms, modern amenities, and an atmosphere that supports complete relaxation. At Fergana Hotel, we take care of every guest by providing high-quality services such as free Wi-Fi, a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk, and other amenities that ensure a comfortable stay. Each room is furnished with attention to detail, and our varied rates are suitable for any type of traveler. Stay with us and enjoy the hospitality that will make your time at Fergana Hotel truly memorable.

food-safety-cert.title: Fergana Hotel Restaurant Receives International Food Safety Certification
food-safety-cert.excerpt: Fergana Hotel's restaurant has officially been awarded the internationally recognized ISO 22000:2019 Food Safety Management System Certification.
food-safety-cert.content:
Fergana Hotel is proud to announce that the hotel's restaurant has officially been awarded the internationally recognized ISO 22000:2019 Food Safety Management System Certification.

The certification was issued by the Management Systems Certification Body of the "Tourism Services Certification Center" under the National Certification System of the Republic of Uzbekistan. The certificate confirms that the restaurant operations at Fergana Hotel comply with the strict requirements of O'z DSt ISO 22000:2019 standards in food safety management.

This achievement reflects our ongoing commitment to providing guests with high-quality dining experiences, safe food preparation processes, and professional hospitality services. The certification covers the organization of catering services, including food preparation, storage, and food service operations.

At Fergana Hotel, guest satisfaction, hygiene, and service excellence remain our highest priorities. Receiving this certification is another important milestone in strengthening trust with our guests and partners while maintaining international hospitality standards.

We sincerely thank our dedicated team for their professionalism and continuous efforts that made this accomplishment possible.

Stay connected with Fergana Hotel for more updates and exciting developments.

quality-management-cert.title: Fergana Hotel Achieves ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Certification
quality-management-cert.excerpt: Fergana Hotel has officially received the internationally recognized ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certification.
quality-management-cert.content:
Fergana Hotel is delighted to announce that the hotel has officially received the internationally recognized ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certification.

The certification was issued by the Management Systems Certification Body of the "Tourism Services Certification Center" under the National Certification System of the Republic of Uzbekistan. This recognition confirms that Fergana Hotel's management system fully complies with the international standards established by O'z DSt ISO 9001:2015.

The certification applies to the hotel's hospitality services and demonstrates Fergana Hotel's commitment to delivering consistent service quality, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring guest satisfaction at every stage of the guest experience.

Receiving the ISO 9001:2015 certification is an important milestone for Fergana Hotel and reflects the hotel's dedication to continuous improvement, professional management, and excellence in hospitality services.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to our team members and partners whose hard work and commitment contributed to this achievement.

Fergana Hotel remains focused on providing exceptional comfort, reliable service, and world-class hospitality experiences for every guest.

smart-in-room-service.title: Fergana Hotel Introduces Smart In-Room Service App for a More Comfortable Guest Experience
smart-in-room-service.excerpt: Fergana Hotel is proud to introduce its new modern In-Room Service Application, created to make every guest's stay faster, easier, and more comfortable.
smart-in-room-service.content:
Fergana Hotel is proud to introduce its new modern In-Room Service Application, created to make every guest's stay faster, easier, and more comfortable through digital convenience and smart hospitality solutions.

The new platform allows guests to access hotel services directly from their smartphones by simply scanning the unique QR code placed inside each room. The application features a clean and user-friendly interface and is available in 10 of the world's most commonly used languages, making it convenient for both local and international travelers.

With the new in-room service system, guests can quickly communicate with hotel staff and request services without needing to call the reception desk. The application includes several practical and guest-focused features, including:
- Wake-Up Call Request – guests can set their preferred wake-up time directly through the app, allowing the reception team to contact them at the scheduled time.
- Taxi Request Service – guests can easily request a taxi through the platform for airport transfers, city travel, or business meetings.
- Problem Reporting Feature – if guests experience any issue during their stay, they can instantly report it through the app for faster assistance and resolution.
- Guest Review Section – visitors can conveniently leave feedback and share their experiences on major international platforms such as Google, Yandex, TripAdvisor, and other popular review websites.
- Additional Hotel Services – guests can request extra amenities and services, including baby cradles, airport transfers, conference hall reservations, and more.

One of the key highlights of the platform is the fully digital restaurant menu, available every day from 10:00 AM until 10:00 PM. Through the app, guests can explore a wide selection of dishes and beverages offered by the hotel restaurant, including:
- Fresh salads
- First courses and soups
- Hot appetizers
- Main courses
- Pasta and spaghetti
- Desserts
- Tea and coffee
- Snacks and fast food
- Mojitos and milkshakes
- And many other delicious options

The launch of this digital platform reflects Fergana Hotel's commitment to innovation, service quality, and modern guest expectations. By combining hospitality with technology, the hotel aims to provide a smoother, more interactive, and personalized experience for every guest.

As part of its ongoing development strategy, Fergana Hotel continues to invest in smart solutions that improve convenience, efficiency, and overall guest satisfaction while maintaining the warm hospitality and professional service the hotel is known for.
